text: {"lessons":["My account value moved substantially even when I made no trades, so I should not mistake inaction for safety or react to short-term fluctuations.","Selling Stock B and Stock D at gains felt rewarding, but a sale should follow my investment plan—not just the urge to lock in a profit.","When adding to several stocks, I should consider my cash needs, diversification, and overall risk rather than buying simply because I can."]}
